name: Bent-Knee Inverted Row
steps: Position yourself beneath a low pull-up bar, grasp it slightly wider than shoulder-width overhand, bend your knees, and plant your feet flat.
Lift your hips and brace your core so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest smoothly up toward the bar by driving your elbows behind you and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower your body slowly back to full arm extension while holding your hips level.
tips: Lead with your chest and keep your chin neutral rather than craning toward the bar.
Keep your hips lifted straight in line with your torso rather than sagging downward.
